components.name: AuraStack Cards
components.description: a high-performance, touch-responsive carousel designed with a custom physics loop. It utilizes GSAP's ticker to calculate Linear Interpolation (Lerp), creating a "viscous" scrolling sensation where the movement feels weighted and organic. The signature "Aura" effect occurs as cards hit the left boundary: they transition into a virtual stack, losing velocity while simultaneously rotating and scaling to create a 3D depth-of-field effect.
components.tags: gsap, horizontal-scroll, draggable-slider, stacking-cards, smooth-physics, lerp-animation, responsive-layout, touch-enabled, editorial-ui, interactive-showcase
